one_liner_zh: 波音最新季度營收年增近14%，但每股盈餘虧損擴大且大幅低於市場預期，反映成本壓力與產能挑戰持續。
one_liner_en: Boeing reported Q2 revenue growth of nearly 14% YoY, but wider-than-expected EPS losses highlighted persistent cost and production pressures.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期，每股盈餘 -0.76 美元大幅不及預估的 -0.31 美元。
highlights_zh: 季度總營收達 22.22 億美元，較去年同期成長 13.96%。
商用飛機與防務業務在營收規模上展現復甦跡象。
供應鏈瓶頸與製造品質管控持續改善中。
highlights_en: Quarterly revenue reached $22.22 billion, representing a 13.96% increase year-over-year.
Commercial airplanes and defense segments showed signs of revenue recovery.
Supply chain bottlenecks and manufacturing quality controls continued to see gradual improvements.
risks_zh: 每股盈餘虧損幅度大於預期，顯示成本控制與利潤率修復速度緩慢。
聯邦航空管理局（FAA）監管趨嚴可能限制產能爬坡速度。
risks_en: Wider-than-expected EPS loss indicates slow cost control and margin recovery.
Stricter FAA regulatory oversight may limit the pace of production ramp-up.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報呈現營收增長但獲利劣於預期的分歧訊號。短中期內，市場將聚焦於波音的交機速率、自由現金流轉正時點以及品質合規成本。建議持續追蹤 737 MAX 產量恢復進度與營運現金流表現。
ai_view_en: View: The earnings displayed a mixed signal of top-line growth and bottom-line weakness. In the near to medium term, the market will focus on delivery rates, the timing of positive free cash flow, and compliance costs. Key metrics to track include 737 MAX production recovery and operating cash flow.
